blocks.text: ● {o|MAP Weapons} {i:map} damage every unit in their attack area. Even if the attacker is a Twin Unit, only 1 machine attacks.
● MAP Weapon attacks can't be met with a Counterattack, Support Attack (Attack Again) or Support Defense.
● There are 3 types: {o|"Around Self"} (the weapon's range is the area), {o|"Directional"} (choose 1 of 4 directions around the machine) and {o|"Target Point"} (choose the area anywhere in range).
MAP Weapons hit every unit in the area, friend or foe. Exception: if Friend/Foe ID is {o|"On"}, only enemy units are hit.
